feed.title: Kevlishvili Group
feed.subtitle: Kevlishvili group develops new ways to represent molecules and materials as data, so that computers can see chemistry the way chemists do. Using these representations, we build AI and simulation tools to design catalysts, smart polymers, and other functional systems for clean energy, sustainability, and medicine. By reinventing how chemical information is encoded and explored, we aim to make discovery faster, more predictive, and more accessible across the scientific community.

entry.title: Kevlishvili Group Website Is Live
entry.content: We are excited to announce that the Kevlishvili Group website is officially live! We will be sharing our research, publications, news, and open-source software on this site. Stay tuned for updates as we continue to grow.
